checks.method: connect with duplicated, cased, and padded scope text and record that the stored set is normalized, deduplicated, and unmodifiable, and that an empty or blank-only scope set is refused outright
checks.expected_outcome: a connection carries exactly the normalized scopes it was granted and cannot be widened or emptied afterwards

checks.method: drive the repository-access rule in every direction and record that a declared access level wider than the granted scopes is refused, that a narrower level is refused, and that the shipped rule cannot be satisfied by a scope it never received
checks.expected_outcome: declared repository access never exceeds the granted scopes, in either direction

checks.method: move a live connection through the RATE_LIMITED health state and record that the connection stays usable, that the limit is visible in the user-facing text, and that the limit is never laundered into a healthy or unknown state
checks.expected_outcome: a rate-limited connection stays connected, says so, and is never reported as healthy

checks.method: request reauthentication, then record a health observation and prove the request is cleared by proof rather than left outstanding, and that the refresh carries the timestamp it claims
checks.expected_outcome: a reauthentication request is cleared by a health observation and not left outstanding

checks.method: revoke a live connection and record that the state is terminal, that no further transition is possible from it, that the refusal is visible, and that ending a developer connection is refused when the reauthentication gate refuses and recorded when it does not
checks.expected_outcome: a revoked connection is terminal, and ending a connection requires the gate and is audited either way

checks.method: walk every action a developer connection can take and record that each one emits exactly one row, that a refused sensitive action is audited as a refusal rather than as an absence, and that no row carries scope or repository-access material
checks.expected_outcome: every action, including every refusal, is audited and no row carries scope material
